alpha.outcome: Actual FIFO sleeve-aware Spot settled cash baskets and fully closed Coin campaigns, all actual fees/funding; unsold residual censored.
alpha.nonoverlap: Actual entry-to-last-settlement intervals, greedily chronological, no profit selection.
alpha.admission: Selected condition predicts negative normalized basket return in each chronological half, positive avoided net cash and beats registered uniform25% basket reduction in both halves. Attribution admits only actual accounts, never default.
alpha.primary: OI new-primary requires actual new signal journals plus positive effect versus matched idle-market control; no baseline BUY invented for cold cash.

cross_market.name: spot-price-discovery
cross_market.signal: Two completed days: spot taker imbalance>.10, perp imbalance<=0; spot price rises both days and prior completed spot/perp basis<=0. No new starts.
expressions: New protected long at legal idle start
Original new-BUY budget75% during inverse confirmed imbalance
cross_market.stop: min ten completed4h lows for Coin; Spot existing ATR/ownership geometry.
cross_market.gate: At least10 nonoverlapping events,3 each original era; net signal return positive each era and coefficient positive after prior20day momentum/RMS. Original full history is development only.
cross_market.inverse_definition: Exact sign mirror on both completed days: spot imbalance<-.10, perp>=0, spot close falls, completed basis>=0. Applied only to original actual feasible owned protected new BUY.

macro_event.name: post-announcement-repair
macro_event.source: Actual finite BLS CPI calendar/Fed announcement receipt; first receipt binds known time.
macro_event.signal: First original legal start between1and7days after a known-before-event release, completed BTC day recovers event-day open after an event-day decline>=2%.
macro_event.gate: Same count/era/net/residual screen as cross-market; no retrospective calendar availability.

execution.name: session-bounded-execution
execution.hypothesis: Existing new BUY IOC failure/partial cohorts; actual fresh book/trades before decision; compare20second limit wait then lawful within-session fallback.
requires: actual same-period trade tape and queue evidence
original remaining deadline and confirmed cleanup/protection
execution.no_queue: WAIT_EXECUTION_EVIDENCE; never infer maker fill from candle touch.

drawdown.name: joint-drawdown-brake
drawdown.held_target: Half confirmed current Coin requested/quantity; never grow or sell external/unknown holdings.
drawdown.clock: Only original legal manual sessions; confirmed protection between sessions; no offline joint executor.
drawdown.high_water: Actual joint cost-net CNY from causal known completed closes and current confirmed snapshots; no lookahead peaks.

implied.name: implied-risk-budget
implied.predictor: Received BTC near30day mean call/put absolute IV; realized7day RMS target.
implied.gate: 10 actual nonoverlap matured periods,3 each chronological half; lower squared prediction loss in both halves than causal20day RMS; directional alpha=false.
implied.size: Original newBUY factor min(1,prior20day annualized RMS/qualified IV), never increase leverage.

protection.name: joint-protection-liquidity
protection.gate: Show a real joint execution gap beyond existing reserve/protection; otherwise ALREADY_COVERED_OR_SUPPORT_PENDING.
protection.size: Deny only new risk with unknown/uncovered current executable protection; actual reduction requires confirmed ownership.

beta.joint_valuation: Reconstruct same actual fills/cash/funding on common minute clocks; accepted Spot daily high-before-low path and official Coin minute mark envelope. Missing held marks keep upper bound unknown. New real Spot minute months only fixed-fill valuation sensitivity, never new account/native execution.

account.selector: Earliest actual eligible event per registered original era, timestamps/causal support only; no profit selection.
account.no_entrant: No account process/market vault loading; report0 explicitly.
account.gate: Each window audited/archived/settled; >=1 independent commitment changed each window; net wealth>=baseline and observed synchronized joint MDD<=baseline+.01 OR observed joint MDD<=baseline*.8 and wealth>=baseline*.95; outperform uniform risk/wealth tradeoff. Window results cannot adopt original full-window default.
account.intake: Source-bound entrant screen and earliest windows produce a bounded actual-account plan. Consume actual separately financed candidate/baseline/uniform raw receipts, never synthetic curve scaling. Unsupported mechanisms or zero entrants create no worker.

budget.temporary_storage: Use workspace task directory with2.2GB free; no duplicate vault.
budget.same_day_sources: Reuse existing ETF/OI/options/funding/book errors; no retry.
budget.risk_minutes: At most selected earliest registered month2020-01 and2022-01; two Spot ZIP+CHECKSUM pairs, plus one CPI calendar. Missing data stays unavailable; no alternate-host retry.

failure_routes: qualify information and mature actual outcomes
failures: Persist every negative/pending case. No threshold/date/start/ratio optimization. Existing nine decisions remain immutable; new derived risk does not alter old gate.
